QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] The Lady in Robes
QuestInfo.0: The information by Maestra Fiametta of the Trading Post should be an important clue in solving the robbery case. You should look into it!
QuestInfo.1: After thinking it over, you've deduced that the thief must have escaped to the east by going through town. Go after the thief!
QuestInfo.2: You concluded that the thief escaped via the canals, and headed there. Then, you ran into the thief! The thief ditched the goods, and you couldn't leave the goods behind, so the thief got away.
